propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Sancti Antonini, Domine, Confessoris tui atque Pontificis meritis adjuvemur:
ut, sicut te in illo mirabilem praedicamus, ita in nos misericordem fuisse
gloriemur. Per Dominum.

translations.caution:
A lay hand missal of the 1945 revision, printed about 1955-56, not an approved liturgical translation and never an altar book. Its Holy Week is the pre-1955 rite, its sanctoral is not the 1962 sanctoral, and its second and third orations are not those of 1962. It is carried only where a 1962 formulary is the same prayer, and nothing here may be used for recitation.

propers.name: Postcommunion
propers.text:
Praesta, quaesumus, omnipotens Deus: ut, de perceptis muneribus gratias
exhibentes, intercedente beato Antonino Confessore tuo atque Pontifice,
beneficia potiora sumamus. Per Dominum nostrum.

translations.caution: Original study translation; not approved for liturgical use or recitation.
translations.text: Almighty God, grant, we ask, that as we give thanks for the gifts we have received, we may receive greater blessings through the intercession of blessed Antoninus, your Confessor and Bishop. Through our Lord.
